characters.name: Gut
characters.description: A young suitor, modestly dressed, likely in simple and practical attire appropriate for traveling. He appears earnest and possibly a bit naive, responding to the hospitality of a poor family that is trying to impress him.

characters.name: Manden
characters.description: The father of the impoverished family, trying to appear prosperous by wearing a jacket with a new sleeve. He uses this sleeve to dust furniture, with an arm held behind his back to maintain the illusion of cleanliness and wealth.

characters.name: Konen
characters.description: The wife in the poor family, wearing a new shoe. She uses this shoe to kick and rearrange furniture, attempting to mask the disorder of their home with confident gestures.

characters.name: Datteren
characters.description: The daughter of the family, adorned with a new headscarf. She peeks into the room, nodding and moving her head to showcase her new accessory, while exclaiming her inability to attend to everything at once.

characters.name: Jenten
characters.description: A beautiful and kind young girl, with simple and modest attire, likely suited for woodland living. She has left her forest home in search of employment. She is portrayed as innocent and earnest, with an expression of hopefulness despite her humble beginnings.

characters.name: Dronningen
characters.description: Royal and majestic, dressed in elegant garments that signify her status. She is kind-hearted and appreciative of fine handiwork, warming to the girl when she delivers beautifully spun and woven linen.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: A handsome prince, dressed regally for a wedding. He exhibits charm and grace, clearly taken by the lovely bride, whom he holds in high regard for her beauty and perceived talents.

characters.name: Første Kjærring
characters.description: An old woman with an enormously long nose, a feature exaggerated to the extent of being several 'alen' long. She displays signs of wear from years of spinning and possesses a slightly mystical essence due to her past contribution to magical tasks.

characters.name: Andre Kjærring
characters.description: An old woman with a notably thick and broad back, barely fitting through doorways. Her condition is the result of years dedicated to weaving, reflecting her extensive experience and tireless labor in her trade.

characters.name: Tredje Kjærring
characters.description: An old woman with large and red, watery eyes. Her appearance stems from a lifetime of sewing, and despite her weary and daunting look, she too shares a kind relationship with the young bride.
